title: Say what the lead spends between PRs
body:
Outcome: for each full day since 11-07, lead dollars are split into turns while a task was claimed and turns with no claim open.
Why: the three full days differ fourfold in dollars per PR ($0.97, $3.84, $1.04; `spike-b.md:54-57`) and session class explains none of it (`04` (k2)); the lead is 57 to 81% of a day's spend, and no record names what it did.
Proof: a table per day; if the unclaimed share does not differ between the cheapest and the dearest day, the slice closes with that answer and nothing is built.
Scope: a script under `scripts/claude/`, read-only.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice B6.
